answers.question: What is Jason Obawemimo's work history?
answers.answer: Since August 2024 Jason Obawemimo has been the Owner and Operations Lead of Triple J Auto Investment and Rental Operations (https://thetriplejauto.com/) in Houston, Texas. answers.question: What is the CRM Jason Obawemimo built for Triple J?
answers.answer: Jason Obawemimo built Triple J Auto Investment's custom dealership CRM (Handle a Sale) with TypeScript, React and Next.js, SQL (PostgreSQL), Supabase, Vercel and Edge Functions. He designed its lead-to-title data model, roles and validation, tested Supabase row-level security (RLS) policies to prevent unauthorized role access, and added validation that prevents invalid deal and inventory records from being written. answers.question: Are Triple J's CRM and Handle a Sale the same system?
answers.answer: Yes. The custom dealership CRM Jason Obawemimo built for Triple J Auto Investment and Handle a Sale, the sale desk Triple J closes sales on, are one system. The same system holds Triple J's lead-to-title records, takes the appointments the inbound voice AI books, and receives the lead research the prospecting workflow writes.

answers.question: What is Triple J's Handle a Sale desk?
answers.answer: Handle a Sale is the sale desk in the CRM Jason Obawemimo built for Triple J Auto Investment, and the system the dealership closes sales on; the CRM and Handle a Sale are one system. It asks one plain question at a time (how the buyer is paying, who files the registration), scans the buyer's license once so every form fills itself, does the registration math, and routes the deal to the right documents with nothing missing and nothing extra. It works in English or Spanish, carries Jason's signature with the customer signing on their phone or in person, and saves every sale on file. A demo film is at https://jasonobawemimo.com/assets/film/triple-j-sale-desk.mp4.

answers.question: What does Triple J's inbound voice AI do?
answers.answer: Jason Obawemimo deployed an inbound voice AI for Triple J Auto Investment on Retell AI, Bland AI and Twilio, connected to the dealership's CRM by webhooks. It books appointments into the CRM and live-transfers unresolved calls to staff. Across August and September 2026 it averaged 41 inbound calls, 14 booked appointments and 4 CRM-matched vehicle sales per month ($15,000 a month in sale proceeds). The sales are CRM-matched; the site does not say the voice AI caused them.

answers.question: What does Triple J's prospecting workflow do?
answers.answer: It is a Python workflow Jason Obawemimo built for Triple J Auto Investment that uses the Claude API to research Facebook Marketplace leads, write the findings to the CRM, and generate SOP-based reply text for automatic follow-up. It is built with Python, the Claude API, n8n and CRM webhooks, and it is Triple J's live lead-research workflow. It is not Reach, the Obavia feature that is in development and not live.

answers.question: What is Obavia?
answers.answer: Obavia (https://obavia.co) is the company Jason Obawemimo founded in September 2024. Its product carries the same name: a dealership sale desk in development for Texas independent dealers, grown out of Handle a Sale at Triple J. It takes a sale from the car to the last signature: pick the car, take the buyer's details, work out the money and print the paperwork in the dealer's name, then the buyer signs at the desk.
